scope.geography: San Jose/greater Bay Area first; Cleveland/Ohio second; nationwide third
scope.selection_rule: Only currently surfaced actionable roles; Bay Area preferred when fit comparable; historical snapshots intentionally retained.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Microfluidics & Applications

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Manufacture and QC microfluidic devices and validate with mammalian cell perfusion and robotic tissue workflows.
key_must_have_requirements: Mammalian cell culture, perfusion, QC, scripting
jobs.why_good_match: Near-exact match to PDMS fabrication, chip perfusion, and flow-balancing platform engineering.
likely_gaps: Execution-heavy rather than independent biological research
jobs.tailor: Lead with porous PDMS membranes, alignment/bonding, flow splitter, perfusion and reproducibility portfolio.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Functional Genomics

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Scale organoid models for CRISPR functional genomics and single-cell readouts.
jobs.why_good_match: Excellent patient-derived organoid and scRNA-seq alignment.
jobs.tailor: Emphasize organoid optimization, donor differences, reproducible phenotyping and single-cell analysis.

jobs.title: Scientist, Cell Biology & Assay Development

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Design mechanistic human-cell assays for small-molecule protein-folding disease correctors.
jobs.why_good_match: Strong link to epithelial ER stress, ROS, mechanistic phenotyping and quantitative imaging.
jobs.tailor: Lead with epithelial stress assays, microscopy, perturbation design and reproducible analysis.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply; include a representative paper or assay figure.

jobs.title: Scientist 1, Single Cell Assay Development

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Develop, troubleshoot and improve single-cell sample-to-sequencing assays.
key_must_have_requirements: Hands-on NGS library prep and molecular biology
jobs.why_good_match: Single-cell sequencing expertise plus microfluidics gives an interdisciplinary bridge.
likely_gaps: NGS library-prep hands-on depth may be limited
jobs.tailor: Separate personal wet-lab NGS experience from sequencing-core services; foreground scRNA QC.
jobs.immediate_action: Check employer application and apply if direct NGS wet-lab requirements fit.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Arrayed Screening

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.job_description: Scale 96/384-well phenotypic screening with automation and ML-ready datasets.
key_must_have_requirements: PhD and typically 2–5 years post-PhD/equivalent experience
jobs.why_good_match: Human disease models, quantitative assays and reproducibility transfer well.
jobs.tailor: Show assay robustness, quantitative microscopy and scalable flow-control engineering.
jobs.immediate_action: Apply selectively and ask whether PhD-stage project leadership qualifies.

jobs.title: Scientist I, Cell & Tissue Operations

salary.note: Posted annual base salary; verify in application

jobs.posting_status: Third-party current listing; employer direct page not independently verified
jobs.job_description: Process human tissues into immune organoids, run immunoassays and establish SOP/QC.
key_must_have_requirements: Flow cytometry and other immune assays
jobs.why_good_match: Primary organoid culture, donor variability and NAM mission fit.
jobs.tailor: Lead with patient-derived cultures, donor QC and SOPs.
jobs.immediate_action: Verify direct company listing and ask about R&D ownership.
